messages:
taylor: FYI p99 for /v1/predict on the latency dashboard jumped ~2x at 03:20 UTC. p50 unchanged. pinging eng-platform because it coincided with routing-policy roll.
jasper: saw that. only the p99 line wiggles, heatmap shows the endpoint buckets with low sample counts. any recent aggregation or sampling changes?
mona: we did change per-route sampling last week to reduce cost (sample 1/10 by default, 1/2 for hot routes). routing-policy-v3 also enabled a fallback path that retries once on outlier pools.		
taylor: retries? are we sure those retries aren't ending up in the rollup as separate requests and skewing the tail?
abel: good call. our rollup pipeline tags requests by request_id but we also have a separate legacy "ingress_id" field used by older collectors. If a retry creates a new ingress_id but same request_id, dedupe should work, but if ingress_id differs and request_id missing, we double-count.
jasper: can you paste the dashboard query?
taylor: panel query (copied):
```
SELECT quantile_from_tdigest(tdigest_merge(latency_tdigest),0.99) AS p99 FROM endpoint_rollups WHERE endpoint='/v1/predict' AND time >= now()-1h GROUP BY time(1m)
```
abel: ok that's tdigest_merge. But even before that, the rollup ingestion pipeline does a pre-aggregation sampling step: it drops 9/10 raw samples for low-cardinality endpoints but preserves all for "hot" routes. If routing-policy-v3 changed which pool is marked hot, the sample composition changes, and tdigest_merge on sampled buckets can shift tails.
mona: additionally, retries produce low-latency early failures then a longer successful call; depending on whether the retry or final hit is kept in the sampled set, tails can flip unexpectedly.
taylor: timeline: routing-policy-v3 rolled at 2024-10-12T03:18Z (CI). p99 spiked at 03:20Z. :thinking:
infra-bot: Deploy bot: routing-policy-v3 deployed 2024-10-12T03:18Z by ci/cd. No failed checks.
jasper: hypothesis: routing-policy-v3 moved some traffic to a pool flagged hot in the sampler, combined with retries producing duplicate-ish records, and the sampled tdigest_merge amplified rare long-tail latencies.
abel: quick repro: I replayed a synthetic trace with 1:10 sampling vs full sampling and with/without retries. Results: p99_ui (tdigest_merge 1m) diverges from raw p99 only when retries + sampling present. raw-sample p99 stable. snippet: 
```
# synth replay
no-retries full-sample p99_raw=320ms p99_ui=325ms
retries + 1/10 sample p99_raw=330ms p99_ui=720ms
```
mona: ok so not a pure merge-window bug; it's interaction between sampling, retries, and provenance visibility.
taylor: recommendation: (1) annotate dashboard with routing-policy-v3 deploy; (2) add provenance badge to hover showing "sampling:1/10 | source:tdigest_merge(1m) | dedupe:off" until we fix; (3) fix ingestion to include request_id consistently so retries dedupe; (4) add a replay test that simulates retries+sampling and fails if UI p99 differs >30% from raw.
jasper: agree. UI provenance badge should be short and machine-readable: e.g., "prov:sample=1/10;src=tdigest;dedupe=false" and link to docs. makes triage faster.
abel: I'll open infra PR to enforce request_id export for all collectors and a migration to backfill recent rollups with request_id where possible. also will add a flag to the rollup docs with sampling_rate.
mona: I'll add the dashboard annotation and a manual note on the SLO page that we saw a false-positive tail because of sampling+retries.
taylor: can the console show "raw-sample p99 (when available)" as a secondary line? even if it's sparse, showing both helps decide if UI spike is real.
jasper: we can add a toggle: overlay raw quantiles when sample_count > N. UX ticket incoming.
infra-bot: Job infra/rollup-backfill started for request_id backfill.
abel: PR for collector changes and replay test opened: https://git/repo/pull/4821 (will tag reviewers).
taylor: thanks. once request_id dedupe lands and backfill runs we should see UI p99 converge back. leaving this thread open until backfill completes. :thumbsup:
